claims.text: Question, diagram and explanation: A solution contains dissolved sodium chloride in water. In an ideal open evaporation model, the water evaporates without salt being carried away. What remains? In this idealized separation, water evaporates while the nonvolatile sodium chloride remains and can crystallize. Real evaporation can also carry droplets, which the model excludes.
The circles are symbolic labels, not molecular structures, and the model omits other conditions or intermediate steps.
